key_insight: SURGENT is a multi-agent surgical AI system that combines planning, collaboration, and retrieval to produce more context-aware perioperative assistance than standard LLMs.
clinical_relevance: It is designed to support surgeons across the perioperative workflow with auditable, guideline-informed recommendations that better reflect patient history and safety needs.
method: Multi-department collaboration agents for perioperative tasks
Retrieval-augmented memory using patient history, guidelines, and biomedical literature
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on five perioperative tasks—case analysis, surgical plan simulation, safety monitoring, complication risk assessment, and rehabilitation guidance—with SURGENT outperforming baseline LLMs and existing medical multi-agent frameworks.
watch_item: Performance is reported from abstract-level evaluation, so real-world safety, workflow integration, and prospective clinical validation remain important concerns.
paper_title: SURGENT: A Surgical Multi-Agent Assistance System Across the Perioperative Workflow
